Everyday tools / Finance

PayRadar

Phoenix Android payment tracking with an updated overview, Turkish search and local reminders.

A Kotlin Android app for rent, bills, subscriptions and instalments, with offline records and local reminders. The former web app has been retired.

Test build

6 November 2026 — the 2.1.5 Android candidate

  • Updated payment overview with overdue, today and next-seven-day counts; monthly estimates remain separate by currency.
  • Turkish search, resettable filters, inline input validation and responsive phone/tablet layouts.
  • Offline reminder recovery, stale-edit protection and safer payment undo.
  • Separate in-app terms, KVKK notice and privacy information. Contract acceptance does not grant notification permission or privacy consent.

The signed 2.1.5-phoenix (12) candidate passed local checks; store publication has not been verified. The owner reports 2.1.4-phoenix (11) as the current store version. Android notification permissions and power management still apply.

PayRadar 2.1.5 — Android screen tour

A 36-second silent tour of the 2.1.5-phoenix (12) candidate using authentic Android emulator screens and sample records: payment overview, cards, editor, separate KVKK notice, dark theme and tablet layout. Store publication of this candidate has not been verified. This is not a live interaction recording or a physical-device test.

The need

Scattered recurring payments make renewals and total spending hard to see.

Approach

The updated Phoenix Ivory / Ember overview keeps monthly estimates separate by currency, with Turkish search, inline validation and phone/tablet layouts. The 2.1.5 candidate adds local reminder recovery, stale-edit protection and improved payment undo. Terms, KVKK notice and privacy information are separate in-app sections.

Current scope and limits

Android closed test. Google Play enrolment is required. The linked page is a download guide, not a browser payment app. Cloud sync is not server-blind end-to-end encryption. Current store version reported by the owner: 2.1.4-phoenix (versionCode 11). New candidate shown in this presentation: 2.1.7-phoenix (14). Store publication of this candidate has not been verified.

Product update prepared on 6 November 2026. An accessible interface is not evidence that every workflow has passed end-to-end testing.
